tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mnyam sbyor dkyil chog bzhugs/ /

oṃ swa sti/ dpal ldan bde chen mgon po ni/ /rigs drug 'khor los bsgyur ba'i sku/ / mtha' yas dkyil 'khor bcas btud nas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga cung zad 'bri/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog gi /rgyud don rtogs dka' mkhas rnams kyis/ /phyogs 'dir rgya cher bshad min yang*/ /rang dang rjes mthun 'gal ba med/ /'di la sa chog ni/ gzhung rnying ma gnyis las spyi dang mi 'dra ba cung zad yod kyang gnad phal cher gcig pas gsang ba spyi'i cho ga rnams dang 'dra bar shes dgos la/ des na/ oṃ bhu khaṃ/ zhes pa'i tshab tu/ oṃ bh+ruṃ ga ga ṇa khaṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes sbyar ba dang*/ srung ba dang*/ phur btab sgrub thabs kyi srung 'khor bzhin sbyar bas 'grub pa nyid do/ /gnyis pa sta gon la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ mchod pa sogs 'dus byas/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/ zhes pa rta mchog gi snying po'am/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li hūṃ/ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po rnams dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams phaiṃ/ zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhu ta pre ta bi shā tsa/ ut+ma da a pasma ra ḍa ka ḍa ki n+ya da ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tshan+tu swāhā/ zhes lan gsum lnga bdun gyi bar du phul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ zhes/ sogs las la gzhol zhing mtshams bcad pa'i bar spyi dang 'dra/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ gnas khang bh+ruṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang pa/ rgya dang tshad yongs su chad pa med pa/ dbyibs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad gyis rnam par brgyan pa/

dpag bsam gyi shing dang bum pa bzang po dang gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pas mdzes pa phyi rol tu dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba/ de'i nang du a dang bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i thod pa mtshan ldan la sogs pa snod kyi khyad par rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ rnams las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me togabadug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ gzugs/ sgra/ dri ro/ reg bya/ chos khams kyi khyad par mtha' yas pa/ rang bzhin bde stong gi ye shes/ rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin phung*/ byed las dbang po mtha' dag zag med kyi bde bas tshim par byed par gyur/ oṃ mahā kro dhe shwa ri sarba dra bya bi sho dha ni āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ gis bar/ oṃ āḥru pa badz+ra hūṃ/ shap+ta/ gan+dha/ ra sa/ spa ri sha /dharma ra tu/ sogs sbyar/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta sogs rol mo byin dbab/ de nas skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin dang*/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od du zhu ba nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de nas sa'i lha mo sta gon ni/ ḍak+ki ni hūṃ dza/ oṃ haṃ/ haṃ gi sgra dang*/ hūṃ gi 'od kyis bskul nas/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa byung*/ tshom bu'i steng du byon pa ni/ sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can/ zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dkar po can/ kyai rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gi las ci dgos pa bka' stsal du gsol/ bdag bskyed ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ pri thi wī de wi bh+yaḥ.ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ mtshan sngags de sngon du 'gro ba'i/ pa d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke ghan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shap+ta hūṃ/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/

sogs/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sha lnga bdud rts-i lnga ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hriḥ pri thi wī de wī bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba tha khaṃ ud ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon sa yi ni/ /lha mo chen mo 'jig rten yum/ /rin chen kun gyis rab gang ma/ /bzang po'i rgyan gyis rnam brgyan ma/ /do shal rkang gdub sgra ldan ma/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma/ /mchod gtor 'di dag mchod nas su/ /dkyil 'khor las ni legs grub mdzod/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ / lha mo khyod ni dpang du gsol/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi stobs bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas nas dkyil 'khor bri/ /kyai rig pa 'dzin pa dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar mdzod cig /oṃ pri thi bi de wī bh+ya ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim par gyur/ sa chog gi skabs nam mkhar btegs pa'i rigs yin na'ang*/ sa 'og nas spyan drangs pa la yid kyis dbyer med bcug nas/ mchod gtor 'bul ba man chad byas pas 'dod pa'i don 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /lha sta gon ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi dri bzang dang dam rdzas kyis byugs/ lhag gnas mi 'tshol ba'i phyir skya thig tsam btab la/ lha'i gnas su dri bzang gis thig le dang tshom bu bkod/ sa chog sngon du 'gro na/ nam mkha'i lha phab pa tsam gyis chog kyang*/ lag len la dam tshig pa'ang bskyed par mdzad pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi dwangs shing thogs pa med pa la/ tshom bu rnams lha so sor rang rang gi gdan ji lta ba bzhin du grub par gyur/

dkyil 'khor dbus ma'i gnas su hūṃ las dpal rdo rje sems dpa' nas bzang po dang mnyam par sbyor ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor shar ma'i sa'i dbus su/ oṃ las sangs rgyas rgyal ba rnam par nas rab tu 'khyud pa rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor lho ma'i sa'i dbus su hrīḥlas dpal he ru ka nas yang dag par 'khyud pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor nub ma'i sa'i dbus su hrīḥlas pad+ma nas rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor byang ma'i sa'i dbus su traṃ las rdo rje nas shin tu 'khyud pa'o/ /mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su haṃ las rdo rje rta mchog nas nges par 'khyud pa'o/ /dzaḥbade mchog ma nas bum pa 'dzin pa rdo rje sems dpa'i phyogs bzhir g.yas bskor gyis gnas pa'o/ /aṃ sangs rgyas nas gar mdzad pa rnams de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhir 'khod/ oṃ gling bu nas ljang khu rnams me nas brtsams te/ sogs/ dzaḥrta mgrin nas 'dzin pa rnams shar sogs phyogs bzhi la g.yas skor gyis 'khod/ de rnams nas zhugs pa'o/ /haṃ sangs rgyas kun spyod ma nas me dpung 'bar ba'o'i bar yang dkyil 'khor snga mas rigs 'gres te/ dkyil 'khor gyi pad 'dab bzhi zhes sogs kyi tshig bor bas 'grub bo/ / hrīḥlas gau rī dkar ser nas gar stabs kyi bzhugs pa'o 'i bar la/ re mig la zhes pa nas bor ba'o/ / maṃ mda' 'dzin ma nas dpyangs pa 'dzin pa/ gtso bo'i phyogs bzhi la 'khod/ maṃ sogs sngar gyi rigs 'gre/ dzaḥrnam gzigs ma dmar mo nas pad+ma'i 'phreng bas klubs pa'o 'i bar la 'dor len sngar bzhin bya/ oṃ dbang bskur ma dmar mo nas sku la nor bu dmar po'i mdangs 'od 'phro ba'i bar la'ang 'dor len sngar bzhin bya/ dziḥgatso bo'i g.yas su nas khro mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /hrīḥ gau rī dkar ser sogs ra bar gyi mtshams la 'khod/ de ltar khro mo nas gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ / maṃ mda' 'dzin ma sogs mi dgos me tog sngar bzhin/

de thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥhūṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ lan mang du brjod/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dza/ la sogs pa brjod kyang rung*/ mchod pa rgya cher bshams nas/ gong gi gnas khang byin rlabs kyi tshig dor nas/ lhag ma sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥhūṃḥ.a dhi bhu hoḥ zhes pa nas/ dam tshig mchog gzhung dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol gyi bar/ rnal 'byor chen po'i yan lag gi skabs nas 'byung ba ltar/ mchod pas mnyes par bya/ spros pa la dga' na dngos gzhi'i skabs ltar mchod pa cung zad rgyas par sbyar kyang legs so/ /de nas spos dang bcas pa'i rdor dril 'dzin bzhin pas/ thugs rje chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /ma lus sems can don mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sras dang bcas/ / stobs mchog rgyal chen rnams la bstod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /mgon gyur las rnams sgrub pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje gsang ba bdag gis bri/ /slob ma rnams la brtse phyir dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor bri bar bdag 'tshal lo/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang*/ /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ /'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang*/ /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan mnga' rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni che ge rdo rje can/ /bde mchog 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar nus pas nyer sbyor bas/ /'gro ba sbyangs phyir bri bar bya/ /de phyir bdag dang slob ma la/

/rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas/ /dkyil 'khor dang bcas thams cad ni/ /nye bar byon par mdzad par rigs/ / zhes lan gsum gyis snyan gsan dbab/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ 'grub na skabs 'dir sbyin bsreg 'bul lo/ /slob ma sta gon ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*/ zhes sogs/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed pa dang nang dbang bskur ba dang*/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs kyis gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ bu tshur shog shig theg chen pos/ zhes sogs spro ba bskyed pa rnams spyi dang 'dra/ bdag gi sdig pa bgyis pa dang*/ /bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /ma lus so sor bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams dang*/ /bsgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs la bdag ni yi rang ngo*/ /sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar/ /skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do/ /bdag gi dge ba'i lam rnams kyis/ /'jig rten 'dir ni sangs rgyas shog /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /bla med gnas su bsgral bar bgyi/ / zhes rgyun bshags dang*/ 'gro ba'i mgon po bdag la dgongs/ /ma lus phyogs bzhugs bde gshegs rnams/ /dus 'di nas bzung sangs rgyas bar/ /bla med bdag la dgongs par mdzod/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams nas sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ lan gsum gyis rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung*/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la zhes pa nas/ de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med par/ /bdag gi sdom pa legs par bzung gi bar yang spro na bya/

nges par dgos pa ni min zhing*/ spros pa la dga' na rdo rje rtse mo rnams gsungs pa ltar gyi/ sdom bzung rgyas pa byas nas sdom pa bzung na shin tu legs/ 'di'i dkyil chog rnying ma las/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun sogs/ slob dpon gyi bka' stsal ba'i tshul du byas pa ni/ don la 'gal ba med mod kyang*/ 'dra min du bcos pa zhig yin pa 'dra'o/ /de nas gnas gsum byin rlabs dang*/ mchod pa bzhi 'bul ba dang*/ so shing*/ khyor chu/ srung skud rnams spyi dang 'dra/ ku sha la/ hūṃ a oṃ/ a hi a/ hrīḥ.a traṃ a haṃ a/ sarba swa pa na ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas sbyin/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag/ sogs/ zab mo'i chos bshad pa dang*/ rmi lam brtag cing ngan na srung ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de nas bum pa lhag gnas ni/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa mchog yin yang 'grub dka' bas/ 'khor lo drug la bum pa re re dang*/ las bum ste drug gam/ de'i steng du bkra shis gyi bum pa brgyad bsnan pa ste/ bum pa bcu bzhi 'grub na'ang legs/ shin tu bsdu na rnam rgyal dang las bum gyis chog ste/ spyi dang mthun par bsham/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa/ lto ba ldir zhing*/ mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul chings dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang bar gyur/ bum pa gnyis yod na/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su/ 'khor lo drug gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi gdan yongs su rdzogs pa grub par gyur/ dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpa' zhes sogs/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi zhes pa'i gnas su/ cha shas dbus ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gnas dang*/ cha shas shar ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gnas zhes sogs 'don pa spos nas/

gong lha sta gon ltar/ dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim/ oṃ sarba bud+dha sa ma yo ga ḍā ki ni dz+wa la sam+bha ra/ maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wa re bh+yaḥ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod thung gis bstod/ me tog 'phreng ba'i gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ 'khor los bsgyur ba drug gi snying po rnams ci nus su bzla/ las bum du rta mchog bskyed na/ cha shas byang ma'i dbus dang las bum du zhes lhan cig tu bskyed pas chog /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bskyed na/ las bum du hūṃ las byung ba'i bdud rtsi 'khyil ba nag po/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum sogs srung 'khor skabs bzhin las/ smad phur pa'i dbyibs su mi byed/ lhag ma 'dra/ sngags kyang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba nyid bzla/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ bzod gsol spy-i dang mthun par byas/ me tog dang bcas pa'i mchod yon phul bum nang gi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i/ bum chu nus pa kun dang ldan par gyur/ las bum gyi lha ni bzhu mi dgos so/ /sta gon gyi lha la gong bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/ yig brgya bzod gsol/

oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha/ zhes nam mkhar btegs/ slar yang mchod pa dkyus ma dang bstod thung gis bstod/ nangs par dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab par gsol ba btab bo/ /de nas thig tshon bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ las byung ba'i thig tshon dkar po/ hiḥlas byung ba'i thig tshon sngon po/ hriḥlas byung ba'i thig tshon dmar po/ traṃ las byung ba'i thig tshon ser po/ haṃ las byung ba'i thig tshon ljang khu rnams de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ dī pa ta dṛṣ+ta ang ku shi dz+dzaḥ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs dang*/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig tshon spyan drangs te gnyis su med par 'dres/ pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ/ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ thig skud sgril zhing*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya su traṃ mā ti kra ma hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes bzlas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ dz+dza dz+dza dz+dza/ zhes btang nas/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta sarba satwa hūṃ/ zhes thig skud drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ gi sngags kyis ye thig rnams gdab par bya ste/ dkyil chog rnam gsum las/ kha lta phyogs sogs mi 'dra ba 'ga' re snang yang*/ rtsom pa po so so'i 'dod pa yin gyi/ rgyud sde 'di'i khyad chos ma yin pas spyi dang mthun par btab bo/ /sngar las thig rdzogs par ma btab na/ de nas las thig gi cha dbye bar bya la/ sngar btab na der zad do/ /thig gdab tshul ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /thig gi bya ba zin pa na/ ye thig la mchod bstod byas nas/ gats+tsha muḥ zhes ye shes pa nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor kyi thugs kar thim/ oṃ badz+ra be kra a kra ma hūṃ/ zhes ri mo bteg nas nang du 'ongs/ hi hi/ zhes sgo'i rtsa thig dbye/ rdul tshon la/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ mang du bzlas/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/

/sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /dpal ldan rgyal po rdo rje sems/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /yang dag bde ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ /dkyil 'khor las rnams shes par mdzod/ / ces dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa nas 'bri zhing*/ tshon bkra brtag pa sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de nas rgyan dgram zhing mchod pa bshams pa ni/ me tog dkar po sangs rgyas la/ /rdo rje can la sna tshogs pa/ /'jig rten dbang la kha dog dkar/ /ser po mkha' las byung ba la/ /tsan dan bdug pa sangs rgyas la/ /rdo rje can la du ru ka /spyan ras gzigs la ka pi ta/ /gu gul rdo rje nyi ma la/ /mar me'i 'phreng ba sangs rgyas la/ /rdo rje can la mar me bdun/ /spyan ras gzigs la mar me brgya/ /stong ni rdo rje nyi ma la/ /sangs rgyas rnams la tsan dan dri/ /rdo rje can la gur gum yin/ /spyan ras gzigs la tsan dan dmar/ /ga bur rdo rje nyi ma la/ /me tog 'phreng ba bdug pa kun/ /de bzhin mar me thams cad dang*/ /spos rnams thams cad ji snyed pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin la 'bul bar bgyi/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ rdo rje can he ru ka dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin rdo rje sems dpa' 'o/ /'di dang phyogs mtshungs rdo rje gur nas kyang gsungs shing*/ khyad par kha zas la/ kha ba tsha ba rdo rjer 'bul/ /mngar ba rdo rje rtag pa la/ /skyur ba rdo rje nyi ma la/ /de bzhin lañtsa 'jig rten rjer/ /rta yi rgyal por thams cad dam/ / bska ba rab tu rtag par bya/ /zhes pa lta bu dang*/ rgyud 'di las slob dpon mchod pa'i yon du gsungs pa/ bu mo shin tu brgyan pa'am/ /de bzhin chung ma sdug pa dag /phul nas rin gyis bslu ba ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog gi yon/ /mi chen dag ni phul nas su/ /slar yang rin gyis bslu ba ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal sbyor ba/ /yon ni mchog gi yon yin no/ /mu tig bzangs dang nor bu dang*/ /shin tu dkar dang ras zung dang*/ /de bzhin rta ni dkar po dag

/pad+ma can gyi yon yin no/ /rgyal srid rin chen ltar rnams dang*/ /gos dang rgyan gyi tshogs rnams dang*/ /de bzhin mchod pa thams cad dag /rdo rje nyi ma'i yon yin no/ /rta mchog shin tu brgyan pa dang*/ /shing rta rin chen bkang ba dag /rta yi rgyal po'i yon yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu/ dngos dang*/ bris pa dang*/ yid kyis bsams pas kyang ngo*/ /de'i rjes su/ lhag chad kha bskang ba'i phyir rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te yig brgya mang du bzlas/ bum pa rnams phyogs phyogs su spyan drangs/ dkyil 'khor la bgegs sbyang ba/ sdig sgrib sbyang ba/ khrus gsol rnams bod snga ma'i lag len ltar spro na bya/ de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ sgrub thabs kyi 'jug tu bshad pa'i gtor chog dang 'dra ba las/ 'khor los bsgyur ba drug gi sngags bor ba'o/ / oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūṃ/ bdag nyid rdo rje rta mchog tu gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas rdo rje khro bo mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa spros/ bgegs bskrad cing mtshams bcad par gyur/ hūṃ bzhi pa drag tu bzla'o/ /rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ yang dag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ gsang ba'i dam can so so nas/ /'du ba'i las ni ma gtogs pa/ /gsang ba nyan par mi dbang ba'i/ /bgegs dang 'byung po thams cad kun/ /da lta nyid du so sor dengs/ /ci ste bka' las 'das gyur na/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas kyang*/ /rdo rje mtshon chen 'bar ba yis/ /rtag tu brlag cing phung bar 'gyur/ /hūṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ yaṃ khaṃ tsakra bi shwa hūṃ phaṭa/ khro bo'i sngags drag tu brjod pas mtshams bcad/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas mkha' dbyings gang ba la dmigs te/ de dag la gsol ba 'debs bzhin tu/ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la bab/ /ces sogs byin phab/ de rjes nang mchod dang*/ sarba da bya gyi sngags kyis rdzas gzhan mtha' dag dang*/ nang gis gtor ma rnams byin gyis brlabs/

rigs rkyang he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor dang rigs bsdus kyi skabs 'dir/ rak+ta yang bshams la/ oṃ mahā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ hrī tha/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs rigs rkyang gzhan bzhi la/ rak+ta mi dgos/ de nas gnas khang dang mchod pa'i yo byad gong bzhin byin gyis brlab/ de nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bshags pa 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ gsang ldan rdo rje che ge mos/ /rdo rje slob dpon smod 'gal zhing*/ /lha spangs mchod la 'khus pa dang*/ /sngags dang phyag rgya spangs pa dang*/ /snod min gsang ba bsgrags la sogs/ /gnyis gsum nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ /yan lag cha shas nyams dang 'das/ /'gyod sems nges par bshags par bgyi/ /oṃ na ma kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba pā paṃ shud+dha shud+dha swāhā/ gzhan yang bshags pa'i khyad par ji ltar 'os pa sbyar bas rung ngo*/ /de nas lag pa byin rlabs/ rang nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa' skur nas brtsams te/ las mdzad par gyur gyi bar song ba na/ mdun skyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gzhal yas khang lha'i gdan dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ lha'i mtshan ma rnams lha tshogs su gyur pa ni/ dbus su dpal ldan kun bzang yab yum dang*/ /bde mchog ngo mtshar bde ma snang mdzad ma/ /slob ma sangs rgyas byang chub chos 'khor ma/ khams gsum rnam rgyal 'dod pa'i dbang mo bzhugs/ /shar du rgyal ba rtag pa yab yum dang*/ /sangs rgyas kun brjod shin tu rgyal ma dang*/ /kun bzang mi bzad snod ma kun ldan ma/ /zhal bzang sprin chen nam mkha'i spyan ma bzhugs/ /lha mo'i dbus su khrag 'thung yab yum rol/ /nub tu pad+ma gar dbang yab yum dang*/ /rnam gzigs sgrol ma sa 'dzin khro gnyer can/ /gtum pa'i dbang phyug sna tshogs pad+ma la/ /pad+ma na bza' pad+ma'i dbang mo bzhugs/ / byang du rdo rje nyi ma yab yum dang*/

/dbang bskur gter ldan rgyal mtshan mchog ma dang*/ /mchod chen ma dang mda' gzhu ral gri ma/ /nyi ma ma dang me 'bar ba ma rnams bzhugs/ de dag kun la phyi nang grwa rnams su/ gling bu pi waṃ rnga chen rdza rnga ma/ /me tog spos dang mar me dri chab ma/ /mtshams kyi dbus su rta mchog yab yum dang*/ /sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje ma/ /phyi dang nang gi dkyil 'khor thams cad la/ /sgo bzhir rta gdong ma dang phag gdong ma/ /snang ba mo dang ro langs ma rnams bzhugs/ /lho dang mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor chen po la/ /gau ri tsau rī rab rmongs bai ta lī/ /puk+ka sī dang gtum mo ghasma ri/ /rme sha ma ste khro mo brgyad po bzhugs/ /rim gnyis grwa bzhir 'da' 'dzin kha ṭ+wāṃ ma/ / 'khor lo 'dzin ma sna tshogs ba dan 'dzin/ /me tog ma sogs mchod lha bzhi dang bcas/ /de ltar gdod nas rnam dag dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du grub par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥhūṃ/ zhes sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ rta mchog gi snying po dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags lan gsum gyis bsangs gtor bya zhing bgegs bskrad/ hūṃ bzhi pa'i sngags cig rdo rje gsor pa dang bcas pas/ srung 'khor gyi sgo phye la/ mahā sa ma ya s+t+wam/ lag gnyis kyis mchod yon 'bul ba nas/ mahā su kha hūṃ/ gi bar tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod pa phul/ 'khor los bsgyur ba drug gi snying po'i mthar/ a be shwa ya a/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ btags pa dang*/ rgyas par spro na/ 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi sngags kyi mthar yang de bzhin du bya la/ mdor bsdu na/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho aṃ bh+ruṃ haḥkhaṃ/ aṃ taṃ baṃ saṃ a ā aṃ aḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ haṃ tshaṃ traṃ dhaṃ aṃ bh+ruṃ ha khaṃ/ oṃ taṃ nas baṃ ho gong bzhin no/ /hrīḥh+ni ni dz+dziḥdziḥhūṃ phaṭa hūṃ phaṭa/

maṃ baṃ yaṃ raṃ a ā aṃ aḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho hūṃ he āḥhoḥ oṃ taṃ sogs gong bzhin no/ / oṃ hrīḥhoḥhaṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ oṃ taṃ sogs gong bzhin no/ / dziḥhāḥhriḥh+ni sogs te/ sa bon sde tshan de rnams kyi mthar/ a be sha ya a dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi lha rnams gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor dang bsre bar bya'o/ /skabs 'di dag tu slob dpon hūṃ mdzad kyis brda' sgo dbye ba dang*/ brda' phyag 'tshal ba bshad pa ltar byed pa legs pa yin te/ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ oṃpra be sha ya phaṭa/ a la la la la ho/ zhes phyogs bzhi nas sgo phye/ spro na/ oṃ hūṃ/ zhes dbus nas sa mnan te/ oṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ shar du'o/ / oṃ hūṃ a phaṭa/ lho ru'o/ / oṃ hūṃ a a a phaṭa/ nub tu'o/ / oṃ ha ma ra duṣ+tan/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ a a a hūṃ hrīḥphaṭa/ byang du'o/ /'di dag bgegs bskrad pa yang yin te/ sgo dbye ba dang 'brel lo/ /brda' sgo dbye ba'o/ / oṃ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /phyogs bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dbus rnams kyi/ /skye 'gro rdul snyed gnas pa kun/ /bde gshegs lha yi dkyil 'khoradabyings/ /phyogs dus kun nas tshogs pa'i lha/ /gnyis su med pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ a ti bhu ho/ sarba ta thā ga tā nāṃ ka ro mi/ a la la la ho/ oṃ ā ti bhu hūṃ/ pra ti o ti bhu/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya yo ga sid+dhi āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa la sogs pa sngags bdun gyis phyag 'tshal ba yin no/ / oṃ āḥhūṃ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' mdun bskyed dang ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ sarba sa ma yo3haṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mang du bzlas/ oṃ dharma dha tu/ oṃ shu n+ya tā/ stong pa'i ngang las/ stong gsum gyi yang thog tu zhes pa nas/ rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor la dbang bskur ro/ / zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin du byas la/

de nas cho ga mdor bsdus tsam la dga' na/ oṃ āḥhūṃ a ti bhu ho/ zhes pa nas/ auṃ badz+ra satwa mahā sa ma ya āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes bzlas pa byed pa'i bar sgrub thabs kho na bzhin byas pas cho ga ma tshang ba med la/ cung zad spros pa la dga' na/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ / lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /nam mkha' mnyam par sprul nas kyang*/ / dkyil 'khor lha la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ shrī sarba bud+dha sa ma yo ga ḍā ki ni dza la sam+bha ra sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil dang*/ pā d+yaṃ/ oṃ lha yi me tog shin tu dmar/ zhes sogs dang*/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du nai wi te 'i bar du sbyar ro/ /me tog la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad 'di rnams/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud las 'byung bas/ rgyud tshig la bcos ma byas pa nyid legs so/ /phyogs 'di'i gzhung gnyis las sbyin sreg gi skabs su 'byung ba la/ rgyud tshigs la cung zad bcos par mngon no/ / oṃ dpag bsam shing sogs rgyu las byung*/ lha yi na bza' khyad par 'phags/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog mtshungs dang*/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan sogs 'bul/ /badz+ra sa ma ye swāhā/ gzhan yang mchod pa rol mo'i tshogs/ /sna tshogs rnam pa du ma dang*/ /dga' ba'i glu dang dbyangs kyi mchog /bkra shis sgra kun gyis kyang mchod/ /badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ shin tu rgyas pa la mos na/ rdor sems lha nyi shu rtsa gcig gi glu dang phyag rgyas mchod de/ 'grub na shin tu gal che la/ de bzhin du rigs drug gi glu dbyangs rgyas pas kyang mchod par bya'o/ /rdor sems lha nyer gcig dang*/ rigs drug gi glu dbyangs rgyas pa ni/ logs su rtogs par bya'o/ /nang mchod kyi sngon du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥtha/ zhes lan mang du bzlas nas/ spros pa la mos na/ rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag / ces sogs gyer/ mdor bsdus na mi dgos te/

oṃ 'byung ba thams cad sogs/ āḥhūṃ swāhā 'i bar 'don/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ hūṃ oṃ hīḥhrīḥdraṃ haṃ/ he pañtsa a mṛ ta ra sa ya na sid+dhi sarba pañtsa sid+dhi hūṃ oṃ hī hri tha/ zhes mang du bzlas la/ oṃ ba hu bi bhi dha dzi ban san+ta ki e she sha ni she sha sa dha bi na ya/ sarba ta tha ga ta dza le pra dza le gurba bi garba sarba sham+ba re hūṃ/ biṣ+ya bi sha hūṃ/ de bzhin tu dzi ban gyi sar/ rā ga dang*/ su ra ta dang*/ ro tra sbyar ba'am/ yang na/ rnam pa mang pos srog gi rgyud/ sogs bod skad du rdo rje'i glu blangs nas/ shan ting ku ru/ pa sh+yaṃ ku ru/ puṣ+tiṃ ku ru/ mahā ra ya/ baṃ hūṃ swāhā phaṭa/ ces glu blang ngo*/ / chos sku kun bzang rgyal ba rigs lnga dang*/ /phyag na rdo rje dri ma med pa dang*/ /rgyal po dza dang u pa ra dza dang*/ /ku ku ra dza mu ti ta dang ni/ / ba hu mu ste sangs rgyas gsang ba dang*/ /dri med bshes gnyen rma lo rin chen mchog /gye re phyogs skyong rin chen gzhon nu dang*/ /go'o tshul byang de sras rnam gsum ste/ /co ro rgyal yon la gsum gzhon nu mchog/stag tsher 'jam pa'i dpal zhes grags pa yin/ /byang chub 'od dang blo gros rgyal mtshan dang*/ /rong ban tshul rin rong zom chos bzang dang*/ /yaṃ zhud blo chen mgo yi rigs byung lnga/ /de yang zla ba 'bar dang 'bum grags dang*/ /dngos grub rgyal mtshan dge slong chos rdor dang*/ /mgo ston dngos grub 'bum zhes rim pas so/ /dbus pa sangs 'bum kun mkhyen chos 'od dang*/ /mi bskyod rdo rje byang chen bsod nams 'phel/ /bag ston pa dang tshul rgyal yon po ba/ /bla chen bsod rgyal grub chen kun blo pa/ /rtsa ba rgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod dam pa 'bul/ /

'khor los bsgyur ba drug gi snying po dang*/ /spro na lha thams cad kyi sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum sbyar bas 'bul/ yang na/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/ zhes btags pas kyang rung*/ byin rlabs mtshan dang nas dam pa bdag la stsol gyi bar yang sgrub thabs bzhin/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /che ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'khor ba'i nyes pa'i ma gos shing*/ /'gro la rjes su chags pa'i sku/ /zla ba ltar dkar rtsa dmar 'gying*/ /rdor sems bde ba che la 'dud/ /stong pa ma yin mi stong min/ /dbu ma'i lam la rab 'jog pa/ /gti mug rgya mtsho zhi bar mdzod/ /rgyal ba rtag pa la phyag 'tshal/ /shin tu gdul dka' drag po la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur bas/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khro bor gyur// khrag 'thung lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal/ /chags chen rdo rje chos kyi sku/ /lta ba ngan rnams sbyang ba'i phyir/ /sgyu ma sna tshogs tshul ston pa/ /pad+ma gar dbang la phyag 'tshal/ /yid bzhin nor bu sbyin pa pa/ /ser snas zil gnon 'gro ba sgrol/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rdo rje nyi ma la phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje las ni brtson 'grus che/ /khro dang nga rgyal le lo 'joms/ /pha rol gnon pa shin tu stobs/ /rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba che/ /snying po'i ye shes kun tu ston/ /mnyam nyid gsang ba chen po'i dbyings/ /'khor los bsgyur ma rnams la 'dud/ /'gro kun sgyu ma bde mchog la/ /bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin sbyor/ /lha mo lhan cig spyod rnams la/ /rab tu dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can tshogs rnams yongs sbyangs phyir/ /rjes su 'brang ba lha mo'i sku/ /bde ba'i gar gyis rol mdzad pa/ /lha mo de rnams la yang 'dud/ /mi zad rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings/ /bla med mchod pas rnam 'phrul ba/ /mchod pa'i lha mo thams cad

la/ /tshogs gnyis sgrub phyir phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgug gzhug la sogs las mdzad cing*/ /'phrin las thams cad sgrub pa po/ /sgo skyong gnas pa thams cad la/ /rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi rol gnas pa'i dam can tshogs/ /sgrub la rtag tu phan par brtson/ /gzhan yang dur khrod gnas rnams la/ /rab dang sems kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes las grub gzhal med khang*/ /bdud bzhi'i stobs ni 'phrog byed pa/ /srung pa'i 'khor lo bcas rnams la/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rab tu dga' ba'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dam pa grub par mdzod/ dam tshig dam pa grub par mdzad du gsol/ /mchod pa chen po thams cad dag par mdzod/ mchod pa chen po thams cad grub pa mdzod/ /a la la ste mchod par 'bul/ a la la ste dam tshig skongs/ a la la ste dgyes par mdzod/ a la la ste dngos grub stsol/ dgyes mnyam longs spyod mchog la rol/ oṃ shrī rā ga hūṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ ru ṭa ma ṭa/ sma ra ta ti/ ru lu ru lu/ pra h+la di dza/ ṭak+ki hūṃ dza/ hu lu hu lu/ a shud+dha sadha/ da sha ya sarbaṃ/ ka ni gu ni hūṃ hūṃ ta gha na ghe ta ghe ghe ṭa ṭa ghe ghe ghe/ ta ghe ta ghe/ ghe ghe/ ta ta/ ta ghe ta ghe/ hen don ṭak+ki hūṃ dza/ ghe ta/ ghe don ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ tra na a la la la la ho/ zhes thal mo brdab pa sogs la rol mo'i mchod pa'o/ / ta ghe ghe/ ta ghan ta ghan/ ghan ghan/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rol mo'o/ / aṃ aṃ aṃ haṃ haṃ haṃ/ baṃ baṃ baṃ dhaṃ dhaṃ dhaṃ/ dam tshig gsum gyis brdung ba ste rtag pa'i 'o/ / dhe kong kong kong*/ dhe badz+ra badz+ra nur ne/ kong kong kong kong*/ hūṃ bh+yoḥhūṃ bh+yoḥhūṃ bh+yo/ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yoḥ beṃ kong kong kong*/ kauṃ kauṃ kauṃ bhe kauṃ kauṃ kauṃ he ru ka'i'o/ /pad ma pad+ma hrīḥ tshar gsum gar dbang gi'o/ / traṃ traṃ traṃ/ ba ba ba ba ba ba ba/ ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa/ tran tra na tra na/

tran tra te/ ṭa tut+te ṭa tut+te/ tut+ta t+ta/ rgyal po ste rdo rje nyi ma'i rol mo'i 'o/ / ṭak+ki hūṃ dza/ lan gsum snyem pa'i 'gros so/ /tra tra tra tra tra tra tra/ 'gyur ba'i 'o/ /ṭa ta ba ṭa ta ba/ hūṃ ṭa ta ba ṭa ta ba hūṃ/ rta mchog gi'o/ / ṭa ta ba ṭa ta ba ṭa ta ba/ ṭa ṭa ba ṭa ṭa ba ṭa ṭa ba/ ṭa ta shin tu myur ba'i rol mo'i 'o/ /yang na/ oṃ ko ko pad+ma pad+ma traṃ traṃ ṭak+ki hūṃ/ zhes rigs lnga char gyis brdung ba'o/ / bdag cag dam tshig sogs brjod/ bzlas pa yang sngags mchod kyi tshul tu bya/ dag dran 'dir byed kyi gsal kha med kyang*/ skabs 'di kho nar byas na legs pa yin no/ /bar 'dir sbyin sreg la sogs pa spro zhing nus na 'bul/ de nas gtor ma'i cho ga ni nang gtor sngar bzhin phul la/ phyi rol pa'i gtor ma ni/ 'di skor gyi gzhung las 'byung ba'i gtor chog rgyas pa'am/ 'bring por na phyogs bzhir gtor ma gtong ba'am/ yang na ma rgyud spyi 'gros la 'byung ba'i phyogs gtor bzhin du 'bul/ bsdu na dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol gtor ma bzhi bsham/ sgrubs thabs las bshad pa'i gtor chog kho nas sngos te phyogs bzhir gtong*/ gtor ma dang sbyin sreg dang rab gnas la sogs pa'i skabs sam/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i tha mar bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod de/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye rgu zhi byed dang po'o/ /de yi nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye rgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/

/'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /sems can kun la phan phyir byang chub mnga' ba po/ don rnams thams cad grub par brtul ba yongs ldan pa/ /tshogs kyi legs dgyes thub pa'i bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ldan lha'i/ /gzhal med khang gi snying po nas ni 'dir gshegs te/ /dbang bcas lhas bskor pa yi bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni= /lo ma me tog 'od 'bar nyams dga' lum+ba'i tshal/ /lha mang dag gis bstan par mgon po bltams pa na/ /srid pa mthar phyin pa yi bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis= grong khyer ser skya'i gnas nas rgyal po'i pho brang du/ /lhums nas bltams pa ston pa bde gshegs zas gtsang sras/ /myur bskrun bdud rtsi'i chus gtor ba yi bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis= /grong khyer dam pa ser skya'i gnas zhes bya bar ni/ /rmad du grags pa chen po lha yis mngon bstod pa/ /bsam yas dge sgrub bsod nams phung po'i bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis= /dge shing nam phyed grong khyer nas ni mngon phyung ste/ /dka' thub tshal du mngon par gshegs shing tshangs la sogs/ /lha yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis des ni= /rab tu 'od 'bar gser dang 'dra ba'i sku mnga' zhing*/ /bai ḍūr+ya ltar sngon po'i rtsa bting steng bzhugs te/ /skyil mo krung bcas mi g.yo mchog gi bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis des ni= /chu bo'i 'gram na tsar ka'i 'phreng gis yongs bskor ba/ /shin tu rmad du byung ba'i srid pa sel mdzad pa/ /klu'i rgyal po'i phyag byas pa yi bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis des na= /shing rgyal drung gshegs byams pas stobs kyis bdud kyi phyogs/ /mang po btul tshe sa steng dang ni nam mkha' la/ /bcom ldan bkra shis rnam pa sna tshogs gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni=

sdug bsngal mtha' dag gzhig phyir rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs te/ /nam gyi tho rangs bdud bzhi po dag rnam btul ba/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni= /grong khyer wa ra na sir drang srong mchog bzhugs nas/ /lha yul dang 'dir shin tu rmad du byung gyur pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo mchog bstan pa yi bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni= /bkra shis gang zhig phan byed dam pa dag byed pa/ /bsod nams dag byed 'phags pa'-i skye bos mngon bstod pa/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa seng ges gang gsungs pa/ /bkra shis des ni= mu stegs byed pa kun gyi nga rgyal gzhoms pa dang*/ / 'gro la bde ba bskyed phyir cho 'phrul dam pa dag nye bar ston pa'i rgyal po'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni= /'gro la phan phyir mtho ris gnas nas 'dir gshegs te/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha tshogs lag na rnga yab gdugs/ /sna tshogs thogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis des ni= /de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i mchog tu nyer gshegs pa/ /man da ra yi me tog mang pos mngon mchod pa/ /lha mchog rnams kyis mngon par bstod pa'i bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis des ni= /lha dbang klu dang mi yi dbang pos phyag byas pa/ /mkha' lding gnod sbyin dri za'i dbang pos mchod gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs bcu ldan pa'i bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog / de nas bar 'dir slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa bya/ rjes su dam tshig gsum gyi glu blang bar bya ste/ shrī su kha badz+ra satwa su bha ga twaṃ a haṃ/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshon don phyir/ / zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /de'i rjes su slob ma la dbang bskur ba bya ste/ 'dir re zhig slob ma la dbang bskur ba ni/ 'don pa bsgyur ba tsam gyis chog pas/ bdag 'jug gtso che ba'i dbang du byas nas brjod par bya'o/

/de yang 'di ltar las thams cad pa'i bum pas bsangs/ me tog la sogs pa mchod pa/ bzhis mchod/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa/ sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ/ lan gnyis kyis mig dar dang me tog gtad/ kyai khyod ci la dga'/ bskal ba bzang la bdag dga'o/ /thugs rjes bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin mchog /slob dpon mgon la skyabs su mchi/ /gtso bo lha mo'i tshogs bcas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog du/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ / lan gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /dkyil 'khor chen po nyams dga' ba/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /snying gar kun rdzob byang sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje'o/ /oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ud pā da ya mi/ yang sngags de nyid kyis slob ma'i lag nas 'jus te nang du khrid par mos/ pad skor lan gsum/ g.yon pa'i thal mo kha phub pa'i steng du/ g.yas pa'i thal mo skan/ mthe chung mthe bong sbrel bas rin chen 'phreng ba bzung nas yol ba'i nang du 'jug par 'dod do/ /bar 'dir rgyun bshags bya ste/ dkyil 'khor rnying ma gnyis las/ thog ma med dus 'khor ba nas/ sogs yod kyang*/ sta gon gyi skabs bzhin/ rgyun bshags dang rigs lnga'i sdom bzung byas na legs par mngon la/ mdor bsdu na gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags nyid byas pas/ don tshang zhing legs la zor yang ba yin no/ /gsang bar gdams pa ni/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad par yang ma yin no/ /oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su kha/

oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /de nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ /oṃ mahā sa ma ya u ta ka ṭha/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par bya/ /dam tshig srungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ/ badz+ra u ta ka hrīḥṭha/ de ring phyin chad khyod nyid kyi/ rdo rje sems dpa' nga yin gyi/ /gang zhig bsgo ba'i las rnams byos/ /nga la brnyas par ma phyed cig /gal te cung zad brnyas na yang*/ /dus min 'chi zhing dmyal bar lhung*/ /ye shes dbab pa ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes thugs/ /sku dang gsung 'phrul las mdzad pa/ /phyag rgya'i cho ga gang dag gis/ /de ring bdag la dbab tu gsol/ / lan gsum/ rang gi rkang mthil du yaṃ/ snying gar raṃ/ mgrin par laṃ/ spyi bor khaṃ/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/ zhes rta mchog gi sngags drag tu bzlas pas srungs la/ bdud rtsi lnga dpa' bo 'bru dgus lce thog tu bzhag / snying ga'i dbus su dpal rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum mam/ gsal bar nus na/ rigs drug gi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i yab yum rnams rjes su chags pa'i bde ba'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad rigs drug gi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ snying gar thim par gyur/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzas kyi dud pas bdugs/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol ba dang*/ rol mo sna tshogs pa'i sgra sbyar te/ oṃ dzñā na a be sha ya/ ra ra ra ra tsā la ya tsā la ya hūṃ āḥhaḥdzhai/ zhes brgya rtsa sogs rtag tu brjod la/ des ye shes phebs na ye shes pa bskul ba dang*/ ma phebs na dbab pa'i don tu/ rnam pa mang pos 'dod chags rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/

/de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sgyu ma bde mchog sgyu mas thams cad rab tu rnam par 'phrul/ / te na te te hūṃ/ zhes glu blangs nas/ a la la la la ho/ sarba ta thā ga ta bi tsaṃ tra ḍā ki ni dzā le/ zhes rtag tu bzlas sngar bzhin dbab/ rnam pa mang pos rab tu dga' ba'i rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /sgyu mas thams cad rab tu sprul rol rnam par sprul/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes dbab/ rnam pa mang po khro bo'i rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /sgyu mas rab sprul rnam par 'phrul/ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ zhes sngar bzhin dbab/ rnam pa mang pos srog gi rgyud kyi sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ rnam par 'phrul hūṃ shiṣ+ya bi sha hūṃ/ zhes kyang dbab ste/ sku dang gsung dang thugs dang ye shes 'bebs pa'i cho ga yin no/ / zhes bshad do/ /skabs 'dir slob ma dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ nam mkha'i kha dog dri zhing lung ston/ yang dag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa ste/ /bsod nams rim pa de bzhin shog /oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ stobs dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' khyod/ /'di ni rab tu bzung bar bgyi/ /oṃ rat+na mā la abhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/

oṃ gyi sngags pa'i mig thur pra yig gis mtshan pas rab rib bsal/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng nyid kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣu dzñā na pra be sha ya phaṭa/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che/ /me tog gang dag lhungs gyur pa/ /de ni khyod kyi rigs kyi lha/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur/ slob ma la skabs 'dir lha ngo ston/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ / da ni dad pa rab tu skyed/ / sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i rigs mchog 'dzin/ /'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang*/ /dngos grub thams cad mngon du 'gyur/ /dam tshig ting 'dzin rjes chags dang*/ /gsang sngags snying po 'dzin par gyis/ / dngos gzhi slob ma'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dbang bskur ba/ 'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas stsal/ /de bzhin bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ / bdag ni rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /bdag nyid dbang stegs kyi steng du gnas shing*/ mchod pa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ oṃ hūṃ ḍa ṭi ta phaṭa/ ces dri bzang gi chu dang*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra swāhā/ zhes pas nyung kar me nang du dor/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes pas ku sha dang bcas pa'i chus gtor zhing bya ba/ byur dang skal ba ngan pa dang bkra mi shis pa thams cad shin+taṃ ku ru swāhā/ las bum mam nang mchod kyis bsangs gtor byas la/ rta mchog gi sngags lan gsum gyi srungs/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba/ sogs tshigs su bcad pa gsum dang*/

spro na gong du smos pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis sogs kyi shis brjod rgyas par bya'o/ /de nas bkra shis kyi bum pa blangs la/ til gyi gong bu bzhin gang ba'i/ /rgyal bas bum pa bzung nas ni/ /'di nyid du ni blugs mdzad pas/ /bag chags ma lus dag gyur cig / ces phyi bum gyi khrus so/ / slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor khro bo bcu dang bcas pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mahā sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ lan gnyis kyis chu gnyis/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa ni/ / zhes pa nas/ s+pha ra ṇa hūṃ/ zhes pa'i bar tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod do/ /rig pa'i dbang lnga la/ cho ga spyi 'gros dang mthun par/ slob ma dbang rdzas gnyis ka'am/ gang rung rigs lnga phyag gnyis par bsgom kyang legs par ni 'gyur la/ 'on kyang skabs 'dir rdo rje sems dpa' rigs rkyang gi dbang la slob ma rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du bskyed cing*/ rigs rkyang gzhan rnams la'ang*/ rnam snang dang he ru ka sogs gang du dbang bskur ba'i gtso bo de kar bskyed nas/ dbang rdzas rnams he ru ka la sogs pa thun mong ma yin pa'i rigs lngar bskyed pa dang*/ dbu rgyan la rigs so so'i dkyil 'khor mi 'dra ba yod pa bzhin du/ gzhan rnams la yang dbang rdzas cung zad mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dang*/ sngags kyi mgo 'dren mi 'dra ba dang*/ dbang gi las byed pa'i lha mo rnams la yang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cung zad yod la/ rigs bsdus yin yang dbang so sor bskur na de dag dgos mod kyi/ chabs cig tu dbang bskur ba la/ la lar rigs kun gyi khyab bdag yin pa'i phyir/ rdo rje sems dpa' bzhin dang*/ kha cig tu drug ka sdom pa bzhin du byas na 'dir de'i dbang du byas nas bshad par bya'o/

/bum chu rnams gtso bo'i bum pa'am/ dung chos la sogs par bsdus/ 'khor los bsgyur ba drug gi sngags brjod/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hrīḥ las dpal he ru ka phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang dung khrag g.yon gnyis shor thod dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ yum kro dhī shwa ri sngo skya thod khrag dang ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya can gyis yang dag par 'khyud par gyur/ dbang rdzas kyi lha'i dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad he ru ka yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dza/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ dbang rdzas kyi lha dang gnyis su med par thim/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs te de zhu ba las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor dang*/ dbang lha yab yum rnams snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dang 'dres/ bdag nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhag cing dbang gi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ sprul pa'i kun tu bzang mo la sogs pa 'khor lo'i bdag mo rnams dang*/ bde mchog ma la sogs pa lha mo bzhi po rnams kyis phyogs bzhi nas khrid cing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi/ sogs dbyangs dang bcas pa dang*/ oṃ lha yi chu ni rnam dag pas/ /rdo rje gsang gsum gnas las byung*/ /rig pa'i lha mo'i tshogs ldan pas/ rang bzhin gcig tu gyur pa yin/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad dam/ 'khor los bsgyur ba drug gam/ rdo rje sems dpa' snying po'i dpa' bo 'bru dgu'i mthar/ a bhi ṣiñtsa/ zhes btags la chu dbang bskur/ de ni me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin he ru kar mtshon pa'i dbang bskur ba ste/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin dpal he ru kar rtogs par bya'o/

/ dbu rgyan gyi dbang la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs la dbu rgyan/ rtse mo lnga pa rin po che'i khang bu sgo can gyi dbus na sangs rgyas lnga bzhugs pa/ dar dkar dmar gyi lag dang bcas pa/ rgyu rin po che sogs khams srog rtsa ba gang yang rung ba dang*/ brgyud thag sangs rgyas drug mtshon pa'i thod pa drug gi 'phreng ba can/ gtsug gi nor bu rdo rje'o/ /rnam snang la rtse mo gcig pa/ rgyu rin po che khog gcig pa/ khang bu dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sku dang thod pa yang gcig pa/ rgyun thag 'khor lo'i 'phreng ba dang*/ dar dpyangs can no/ /he ru ka'i ni rgyu rin po che sna tshogs pa/ rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/ khang pa sgo can du rang nyid zhugs pa/ rdo rje'i 'phreng ba can no/ /pad+ma gar dbang gi yang de dang 'dra ba las/ nor bu dmar pos brgyan pa pad+ma'i 'phreng ba can dang*/ rdo rje nyi ma la dbu rgyan rtse mo brgyad pa/ thor tshugs kyi rtse mo la rin po che 'bar bas mtshan pa la rang nyid bzhugs shing*/ rin po che'i 'phreng ba can no/ /rta'i rgyal po la de dag las ji ltar rigs pa'o/ /yang na rigs lhag ma rnams la/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje rin chen phyed/ /rdo rje rigs la rdo rje yin/ /spyan ras gzigs la sangs rgyas sku/ /nor bu 'dzin gyi nor bu yin/ /zhes kyang bshad do/ / oṃ swa bhā wa= dbang rdzas cod pan mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las/ traṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje nyi ma/ zhal bzhi ser ba/ phyag dang po gnyis mda' dang gzhu/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i pad+ma bsnams pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo rin po che dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ dpral par auṃ/ sogs 'don pa bsgyur ba ma gtogs gong gi rigs 'gre/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbu rgyan rgyal ba rigs lnga khang bu dang bcas pa dang*/ thod pa'i 'phreng ba dang dar dpyangs dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi/

/rin chen las byung dbu rgyan che/ /thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa'i/ /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ba ra ta ka badz+ra a ra li ho/ a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/ thod pa'i mtshan ma drug dang bcas pa'i dar dpyangs yang bcings te/ hūṃ badz+ra ka pā la a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ des ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin rdo rje nyi mar mtshon pa'i dbang bskur ba ste/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin rdo rje nyi mar rtogs par bya'o/ /rdo rje'i dbang ni/ swa bhā wa= rdo rje mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ hrīḥ las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis chos 'chad kyis pad+ma'i sdong bu gnyis dang*/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo pad+ma dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ dpral par oṃ/ sogs gong bzhin las 'don pa bsgyur te/ rdo rjer gyur/ oṃ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje gsang ba chen po'i don/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur te/ /rab tu grub phyir bzung bar gyis/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ lan gsum du gsor te snying gar gtad/ oṃ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag / ces rdo rje'i de kho na nyid brjod do/ / de ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin pad+ma gar dbang du mtshon pa'i dbang bskur ba ste/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin pad+ma gar dbang du rtogs par bya'o/ / dril bu'i dbang ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ dbang rdzas dril bu/ haṃ las rdo rje rta mchog ljang khu/ zhal gsum steng zhal rta gdong ljang khu/ phyag dang po gnyis sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ sna tshogs pad ma/ 'og ma gnyis pa dang gsum pa rang ral gri 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang skya gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/

khro bo khro mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /dpral par oṃ/ sogs gong bzhin la 'don pa spos te dril bur gyur/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /oṃ a dhi pa ti s+t+wam a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ dril bu bkrol bzhin du/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog/dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyur/ / zhes dril bu'i de kho na nyid bzung*/ de ni bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin rta mchog dpal tu mtshon pa'i dbang bskur ba ste/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin rta mchog dpal tu rtogs par bya'o/ /dkyil chog rnying ma gnyis nas bshad pa ltar gyi dbang du byas pa ni de ltar yin la/ yongs nas slob dpon gyi dbang la sogs pa/ 'og tu byed pa 'di rigs la/ rdo rje dril bu'i dam tshig bzung ba yang 'dir mi byed par de skabs byas na legs pa yin no/ /ming gi dbang ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa/ sogs/ dbang rdzas rdo rje dril bu/ oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po/ dkar ser dmar ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis chos gos dang lhung bzed/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mkhar sil dang glegs bam 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo 'khor lo dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ dpral par/ sogs 'don pa bsgyur te/ rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ thabs shes sbyor ba ste 'khyud rgyas rdor dril spyi bor bzung la/ gang phyir chos rnams rnam dag pas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rang bzhin nyid/ /dbang po'i spyod yul gang dang gang*/ /bde mchog sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /oṃ kye dpal che ge mo/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta ho/ gsang ming dran par bya/ de ni chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin/ rnam par snang mdzad du mtshon pa'i dbang bskur ba ste/

chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin dpal rnam par snang mdzad du rtogs par bya'o/ / de nas phan yon dang nyes dmigs sgrags pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog kyang*/ /rgyas mi thebs shing mi rmongs te/ /de la gnod par mi 'gyur ro/ / sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /sdom pa nyams par khyed byed na/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje 'dzin/ /lha rnams dang ni mi rnams dang*/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /de dag la ni snying ring nas/ /snying las khrag chen 'thung bar 'gyur/ /sems can khams rnams ma lus don/ /srid pa shin tu dag bya'i phyir/ /mi 'gog chos nyid sbyor ba yis/ /rtag pa nyid du bsgrub par bya/ /bdag gi ngo bo rnams spangs shing*/ / dka' thub kyis ni gzir mi bya/ /ci bde bar ni bde bar spyad/ /'di ni phyi dus sangs rgyas yin/ /rnal 'byor longs spyod thams cad la/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /ma 'jigs khyod la sdig pa med/ /dam tshig 'da' bar dka' ba'o/ /grub pa gcig pu gcig la spyod/ /lhan cig spyod dang rjes spyod sdug /sangs rgyas byang chub bla med yin/ /yan dag nyid kyis rtag tu bsten/ spro na de nas/ slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ spyir gong du thun mong du maṇ+ḍal gsol btab gnyis song bas 'dir ma byas kyang chog go / bdag nyid rdo rje slob dpon mchog tu mnga' gsol ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus/ dbang stegs kyi steng du gnas shing mchod pa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ bdag nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba chen po nas rnam par brgyan par gyur/ dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bu mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ dang a las kun tu bzang po dkar po/ dkar sngo dmar ser ba'i zhal bzhi phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dar dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/

yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma rang dang 'dra ba'i sku can gyis 'khyud par gyur/ dpral par oṃ/ sogs gong bzhin 'don pa spos pa las/ zhu ba las rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya che/ /zung cig yang dag bzung bar bgyi/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon che/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ / zhes ched du brjod nas/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ mahā badz+ra hūṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha/ e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra ya mi hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ bdag nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba chen po'i pang du gnas pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rig ma/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum kun tu bzang mo lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i na tshod can du gyur pa la 'khyud pa tsum pa dang mnyam par sbyar ba las/ yang dag pa'i bde ba dam pa thob par gyur/ yid kyi lus rten de nyid ni/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags/ oṃ mahā kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/

gzhung rnying ma gnyis nas spyod pa'i brtul zhugs ma bshad kyang*/ slob dpon rin chen rdo rjes bshad pa ltar bya ste/ rgyas pa byed na'ang ma rgyud spyis rigs 'gre ba gzhan du shes par bya shing*/ bsdus pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya 'di/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u lhung bzed dag /byin pa dpa' bos bzung bar gyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma ru/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs pa/ /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag kha ṭ+wāṃ ga da rnal 'byor snod/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ / zhes so/ /rin chen rdo rje'i lugs la slob dpon gyi dbang ni sngon du 'byung yang*/ 'di cho ga rnying ma'i nang du 'jug par 'dod na skabs 'dir bya ste/ dam tshig gsum po rdo rje brtul zhugs su byed pa'i lugs yin pa'i phyir/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kyi rjes su spyod pa'i brtul zhugs 'byung ba ni thams cad kyi spyi 'gros yin pa'i phyir ro/ /spyod pa'i brtul zhugs byed pa ni nges par legs te/ rgyud 'dir bskyed rim gyi rig pa'i brtul zhugs dang*/ spros bcas kyi spyod pa rtsal 'don du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas gzhung rnying ma gnyis nas mi gsal yang*/ spyi dang mthun par chu dbang bskur na spyi ldog nas legs par mngon zhing*/ gzhung rnying gnyis kyi lugs la/ cod pan dang 'di'i bar lnga po 'di/ chu dbang gi rjes 'gro'i dbang zhes btags nas/ 'dir chu dbang mi byed pa nyid de'i rang lugs su ni snang ngo*/ /gang ltar yang bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs sngon du 'gro ba'i rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhā/ zhes me tog dor zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol lo/ /de nas mchod pa ni/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' tshogs dang*/

/shes rab thabs bcas snyems can gyi/ /gar mchod bde ba'i dga' ston gyis/ /oṃ badz+ra la s+ya hūṃ/ sgeg dang bcas pa'i 'phreng ba 'phangs/ /sangs rgyas kun sogs rnal 'byor ma/ /de ni 'bral bar mi 'gyur te/ /'phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ / oṃ badz+ra mā le hūṃ/ lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyis blang bar gyis/ /des ni rnal 'byor ma de dang*/ /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra gī te hūṃ/ de nyid thal mo gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par gyis/ / sangs rgyas 'dul ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis/ /oṃ badz+ra nirti hūṃ/ sangs rgyas rnams la spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis/ /oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūṃ/ sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pa/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ/ chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas/ /pad+ma gar dbang rang nyid de/ /sems can ma rig ldongs rnams la/ /ye shes sgron me snang bar gyis/ /oṃ badz+ra āḥlo ke hūṃ/ khyod kyis rgyal la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang*/ /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yis/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bgos/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūṃ/ de dag ni slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tre a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrī/ zhes mig thur dang*/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/

/'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skyes/ / zhes me long dang*/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ / zhes dril bu dang*/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /gsal zhing dwangs la rnyog pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gtso/ /dzaḥbadz+ra dṛṣ+ti sa ma ke ma ṭa/ zhes mda' gzhu sbyin/ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bha ga raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ a deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ khyod kyi the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo kun tu ni/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /sngar bshad tshul gyis cho ga yis/ /skye bo kun la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na rgyal ba la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ / ces chos bshad dang*/ mdor na 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar 'dul ba sna tshogs kyis/ /rdo rje'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /bde gshegs/ khro bo/ pad+ma/ rin chen/ las kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ / zhes te rigs lnga'i sprul bshad do/ /mdor bsdu na/ me long nas 'di'i bar ma byas kyang rung la/ rigs drug gi sprul bshad kho na byas kyang legs so/ / bdag gzhan don grub las kyi tshogs/ /thun mong 'bring po mchog gyur pa'i/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag dgug pa dang*/ /sdang gnod rengs pa'i las kun dang*/ /dbye rmongs skrad pa'i cho ga rnams/ /thog pa med par sgrub par gyis/ / rnam shes sgrub dang ye shes sgrub/ /phyag rgya shes pa'i dngos grub dang*/ /thams cad grub cing grol ba yis/ /don gnyis yang dag sbyor bar gyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gnas 'jug cing*/

/sku gsung thugs mchog yon tan rgyan/ /'phrin las bdag gzhan gnas sbyar ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dngos grub bsgrubs/ / zhes las dang dngos grub kyi sgo nas rjes su gnang ngo*/ / 'di ltar ngas khyod lung bstan te/ rdo rje dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag /dngos po mchog tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las grol/ /kyai/ che ge mo/ zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa bhur+bhu wa swaḥ 'dod chags bral ba lta bur sdig khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral ba/ khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /mahā sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyur/ /sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bri/ khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas ni/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /lung bstan zhing gzengs bstod pa'o/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /zhugs pa dang ni mthong bas kyang*/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol nas/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'ching ba yongs med de/ /tshugs med thub par mi 'gyur bas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las 'das so/ /rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya ni/ gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tsom med/ /byang chub sems ni yongs mi spangs/ dam pa'i chos la mi smad cing*/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis/ /de nyid nges par bstan mi bya/ /rdo rje dril bu mi spang ste/ /slob dpon dag la gus par bya/ /rang gi bdag nyid yongs spangs te/ /dka' thub kyis ni mi gdung zhing*/ /ci bde bar ni bde ba zung*/ /'di ni ma byin rdzogs sangs rgyas/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por gnas pa dang*/

/der ni bdud las rnam rgyal zhing*/ /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /der ni sangs rgyas rigs thob par/ /khyed rnams the tshom med pa yin/ /dbang 'di bskur ba tsam gyis ni/ /slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur/ slob dpon nyid kyang bde ba yi/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi dam tshig yin/ /de kho na nyid ston par spro na/ rgyas par gzhung rnying ma las shes par bya'o/ /mdo tsam mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba ltar bya zhing*/ slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid ni/ dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang*/ /stang stabs 'dug stangs bzlas brjod dang*/ /sbyin sreg mchod pa las la sbyor/ /slar bsdu ba yi rnam pa'o/ /de ltar de kho na nyid bcu ni slob dpon gyi bya ba'o/ /de ltar na bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ ji ltar snang ba thams cad lha'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i bde mchog gi ye shes mngon du byas par mos/ gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ dpal ldan mgon po bde ba che/ /bde chen bde ba'i gnas na bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i bde stsol mdzad/ /byang chub sems dpa' che rnams kyi/ /yang dag don mchog rnam dag pa/ /ji ltar de nyid bdud rtsi yis/ /mchog gi dbang ni bskur ba bzhin/ / de bzhin bdag la'ang 'gro ba yi/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar mdzod/ / rnal 'byor bdud rtsi dri med mchog /mi shes pa yi rab rib sel/ /gang gi byang chub bla med pa/ /de ring bdag gis thob par mdzod/ / lan gsum/ bu khyod ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /rgyal ba kun gyi bde chen sbyin/ / zhes gnang ba rtsal/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyag rgya shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par gyur/ rjes su chags pa rnam mang*/ nas thams cad kyi dri ma sbyangs par gyur/ gyi bar rjes su rnal 'byor bzhin/ de lta bu'i lhan cig skyes pa'i rten du gyur pa/ kun da byang chub kyi sems mthe bong dang*/

ming med kyis blangs nas lce thog tu bzhag / ji ltar rgyal ba bde gshegs kyis/ / rang gi sras mchog dbang bskur bzhin/ /byang chub sems te dag pa'i chos/ / rtog pa'i dri ma dag par bya/ /oṃ mahā bo dhi tsit+ta sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ a ho mahā su kha/ ched du brjod pa brjod/ de ltar gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ sgyu ma chu zla lta bu bdag byin rlabs pa'i bde mchog gi ye shes mngon du byas so/ / yang sher dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsol btab gsang dbang bzhin nam/ bcom ldan 'das zhi ba chen po sogs dgyes rdor ltar ram/ skyob pa skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs/ /sgyu ma bde mchog bdag skyob mdzod/ /rgyu med par ni thugs rje che/ /mgon med bdag gi mgon mdzod cig /bdag nyid che khyod ji lta bar/ /gtso bos bdag kyang de ltar mdzod/ / 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying pa bdag la skyabs su gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /zung cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /bzung la mchod pa rtag tu gyis/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro ba gsum du dag pa yin/ /de phyir 'di dang bral bar ni/ khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /dngos grub mchog kyang yongs med do/ /lha mo des gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar byas te/ rmad byung gsang ba'i pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /rtag tu rim bzhin spyod byed na/ /de nyid bde chen 'bral mi 'gyur/ /chos dbyings 'di ni rnam par dag /sems can thams cad rab sgrol byed/ /nang gi rtsa yi 'khor lo la/ /pad+ma zhes ni rab tu brjod/ /bha ga'i mkha' dbyings nam mkha' bzhin/ /'byung ba bzhi po dag gis brgyan/ /de yi dbus su gnas pa ni/ /de nyid bdud rtsi bde chen gzugs/

/bhañdza mo k+ṣa hoḥ yang dag pa'i rig ma dang mnyam par sbyar ba las/ dga' ba bzh-i'i rim pas lhan cig skyes pa mngon du byas par gyur/ de ltar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin bde ba chen por rtogs pa'i bde mchog gi ye shes mngon du byas/ bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ / lan gsum/ de ltar yang*/ sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun gyis dngos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ / zhes pa dang*/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /rnam gsum phyag rgya gang rung las/ /gnyis med bde ba'i ye shes stong*/ /mngon sum mnyam myong rgyud la skye/ / zhes pa ltar cung zad mnyam par bzhag go khyod kyis srog chags bsad par bya/ /rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /ma byin par yang blang bar bya/ /'dod pas log par g.yem par bya/ /rdo rje ma dang byang chub sems/ /srog gi phyir yang btang mi bya/ /dran pa gsal bas bzung byas nas/ /lhag pa'i lha bzhin rin chen tog / dbang bzhi pa thob pas shin tu rnam par dag pa lhan cig skyes pa'i bde mchog gi ye shes mngon du byas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs dang dge ba bsngo/ rjes chog ni mchod pa bshams/ gong bzhin byin rlabs bya/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa sngags tsam gyis phul nas/ bstod pa mnyam nyid mi g.yo mas bstod/ spro na bar 'di bskang ba dang*/ bshags pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor lha'i bkra shis dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ rdo rje'i glu dbyangs la sogs pa bya/ ma 'grub na mos pa tsam du byas nas/ gsol btab dang*/ yig brgya dang*/ bzod gsol rnams spyi dang mthun par byas/ ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs byas la/

bdag srung ba dang*/ smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /rdul tshon gyi cho ga zhag sbrel mar byed pa'i nyi ma snga ma rnams la yang de bzhin no/ /dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol bar byed na/ oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+taḥ zhes lan mang pos ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg la/ sngags tsam gyi sgo nas mchod pa phul/ bstod thung sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can= sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra gats+tsha muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes bdag nyid la bsdu ba lan gsum byas nas gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun par bsdu/ yang phur bu'i khro bo la mchod bstod dkyus mar byas nas phur bu phyung tshogs kyi 'khor lo'am/ ma grub na gtor ma btang*/ smon lam dang shis brjod bya ste/ de dag thams cad ni chos spyi 'gros dang 'dra'o/ /dpal sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di la/ slob dpon bram ze rin chen rdo rje cho ga'i rim pa sgrig lugs legs shing*/ zhal gsal ba slob ma dbang bskur gyi thad rnams/ bshad rgyud rdor 'phreng ngam/ dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang chog dang mthun shas che ba'i dkyil chog khyad par can bde ba skyed mar grags pa zhig mdzad yod na'ang*/ deng sang gi dbang rgyun 'di rnying ma yin pas/ gtso cher dkyil chog rnying ma gnyis dang mthun par byas la/ 'gyur khyad rnams 'gyur bde ba'i phyogs dang mthun par byas/ rgyud sde gzhan gyi rgyud tshig la bcos slad ltar snang ba 'ga' re 'dug pa/ so so'i rgyud tshig bzhin du bcos/ dkyil chog rnying ma 'di gnyis/ gsang sngags rnying ma dngos yin yang*/ chog sgrigs rnams rnying ma bka' gter zhes phyogs 'di na grags pa rnams dang*/ mi 'dra bar/ gsar ma'i cho ga rnams dang khyad par mi snang ba'i phyir/ cho ga'i rim pa mi bde ba 'ga' re yod pa rnams/ dkyil chog spyi dang mthun par yang sbyar ro/

/de la slob dpon ku ku ra dzas mdzad pa'i gsang don rnam par bkod pa drug dang*/ cho ga lnga pa dang*/ dbang mchog rnams sdom pa rang gzhan gyi don nyams su blang ba'i lag len cha tshang ba gcig yin la/ slob dpon hūṃ ka ras mdzad pa'i he ru ka'i sgrub thabs dang*/ yan lag bzhi'i snang ba dang*/ dbang chog ste gsum sdom pas kyang cha tshang gcig ga

ོ /de gnyis nang sel mi 'dra ba 'phran bu ma gtogs/ rkang pa gcig par snang zhing rgyud dang 'grel pa rnams dang rin chen rdo rje'i dkyil chog sogs las/ de dag dang mi 'dra ba mang du snang gzhan sgrub thabs thor bu pa 'ga' re yang ni snang ngo*/ /ku kur ra dza dang*/ hūṃ mdzad kyi gzhung rnams dang*/ brgya byin sdong po'i 'grel chen rnams tshig legs shing don gyi dbyings bzang ba/ mkhas grub khyad par can gyis mdzad par ni the tshom med la/ slob dpon de dang de dag gis mdzad nges pa'am/ bstan pa snga dar gy-i lo tsā ba chen po 'ga' zhig gis de dang de'i man ngag zin bris kyi tshul du bkod pa yin brtag par bya ba'i gnas te/ tshig zur dang brjod tshul mang po zhig la/ rgya gzhung kho na min nam snyam pa yang snang ngo*/ /yang slob dpon de dang des mdzad pa dngos yin du chug kyang*/ bar bar du go bde ba'i phyir tshig sna bsrings pa yang srid de/ gang ltar yang gzhung bzang por ni snang ngo*/ /'di la bod kyi mkhas pas lag len gsal por sbyar ba'i yi ge gzhan nyung bar snang zhing*/ phyis byon gyi mkhas grub 'ga' zhig gis mdzad pa mthong yang*/ rgyas ches pa dang go dka' bar gyur pas dus mtha'i 'gro ba la phan chung bar snang ngo*/ /des na 'di/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas tshig zor yang zhing*/ don tshang la ngag 'don lhan thabs sogs la ma ltos par bklags chog tu sbyar ba yin no/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud thams cad kyi/ /rtsa bar grags pa'i chos mchog 'di/ /shin tu dar bar gyur cig snyam/ /lhag bsam dag pas 'di bris te/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba ni/ /ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar pos/ /'gro ba'i mi shes mun bsal nas/ /bde chen lam bzang mthong bar shog/ // maṅgaṃ laṃ/ zhus dag/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/mnyam sbyor dkyil chog bzhugs/ -PAGE 322--PAGE 321--PAGE 281-
